"""Read-only checkpoint demand census; never constructs or activates a lexicon."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import sqlite3
from collections import Counter
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from nltk.corpus import brown

from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.completion import _priority_source
from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.epoch import fingerprint
from scripts.audit_lexicon_runtime import PROBES
from scripts.audit_lexicon_sentences import _mass

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parents[2]


def save(name, value):
    path = HERE / name
    if path.exists():
        raise ValueError(f"FROZEN_RECEIPT_ALREADY_EXISTS {path}")
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")


def prefix(counts):
    result, mass = [], 0
    for word, count in sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0])):
        result.append(word)
        mass += count
        if 10 * mass >= 9 * sum(counts.values()):
            break
    return result


def main():
    priority, frequency = _priority_source("zipf", None)
    genres, exclusions = {}, {}
    for genre in brown.categories():
        counts, excluded = Counter(), Counter()
        for word in brown.words(categories=genre):
            (counts if any(c.isalpha() for c in word) else excluded)[word.casefold()] += 1
        genres[genre] = dict(counts)
        exclusions[genre] = dict(excluded)
    common = set(prefix(frequency))
    for counts in genres.values():
        common.update(prefix(counts))
    archive = Path(brown.root.path).parent / "brown.zip"
    corpus_digest = fingerprint(archive)
    demand = {
        "common_forms": sorted(common),
        "frequency_source_sha256": priority["sha256"],
        "corpus_source_sha256": corpus_digest,
        "frequency_counts": frequency,
        "corpus_genres": genres,
        "denominator_rules": {
            "frequency": "Existing _priority_source SUBTLEX positive counts, exact complete normalized forms; blank/zero rows excluded by the existing source parser.",
            "corpus": "All Brown tokens containing at least one alphabetic character, casefolded without lemmatization. Punctuation-only and numeric-only tokens excluded and counted. Contractions and hyphenated forms retained.",
            "cohort": "Union of minimal descending-count, spelling-tiebroken 90%-mass prefixes in frequency and EVERY Brown genre; no semantic result used in selection. All dictionary definitions and tail senses retained.",
        },
        "exclusions": {"frequency": priority["excluded_records"], "corpus_by_genre": exclusions},
    }
    save("ssl-api-runtime-token-demand.json", demand)
    save(
        "ssl-api-runtime-workload-freeze.json",
        {
            "format": "GSE.checkpoint-workload-scope-freeze/1",
            "frozen_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            "authority": "LEXICON_CONSTRUCTION_DESIGN.md mandatory checkpoint-workload section; direct user checkpoint priority 2026-11-24",
            "token_demand_sha256": fingerprint(HERE / "ssl-api-runtime-token-demand.json"),
            "frequency_source": priority,
            "independent_corpus": {"path": str(archive), "sha256": corpus_digest, "genres": brown.categories()},
            "cohort_forms": len(common),
            "coverage": {
                "frequency": _mass(frequency, common),
                "genres": {genre: _mass(counts, common) for genre, counts in genres.items()},
            },
            "operations": {
                "lexical": "Exact definition/source/role identity, signed ordinary-bank queries, per-target hierarchy, explicit zero versus unresolved domains, all competing senses retained.",
                "sentence": "Public GSEEncoder trace -> from_trace -> resolve/evaluate_tree -> emit_contract; event/argument order, ordinary/function ambiguity, he/He, I/YOU, WANT, BE, anatomy, NOT/VERY and duration.",
                "queries": "entities, predicates, clauses, axis_of_comparison, is_argument_swap_of, is_logically_equal_to, propositions, polarity, commitment and claim_key.",
                "document": "encode_document_utterance_events -> MultiScaleDoc; cross-sentence reference, speech deixis, paragraph views, read_fold, narrative graph and cassette identity resolve-or-abstain.",
                "inference": "KnowledgeBase public event/type queries and exact claim admission, source chains, conditional derivation, negation and noncommitted modal/reported content exclusions.",
                "profile": "text_profile structural/lexical/affect populations with explicit unavailable values; no unknown-to-neutral conversion.",
                "auxiliary": "GSEDecoder and GSEPipeline public vector APIs retain their existing semantic validation obligations; vector similarity is not an identity resolver or semantic correctness proof.",
                "orthogonal": "SymbolicSpellCheck spelling resource, SparseWiki world grounding and Regenesis reasoning retain their own resources; lexical checkpoint cannot certify missing world data.",
            },
            "runtime_development_cases": [
                {"id": name, "text": text, "expected_top_operation": op} for name, text, op in PROBES
            ],
            "final_holdout_policy": "New source-warranted final lexical labels are frozen separately before evaluation. Existing sentence/runtime cases and tests are development diagnostics. Any inspected final used to tune construction needs replacement, never relabeling.",
            "acceptance": "No known wrong assertion, missing required component, critical abstention or refusal; >=90% eligible token mass in both sources and genre slices is coverage, NOT semantic accuracy. Full replay, two-sided per-form/source/missing-sign audits, real runtime and repository gates required. Scope is not narrowed after failures.",
        },
    )
    candidate = ROOT / "data/lexicon_builder/2026-11-12/ssl-explicit-genera/checkpoint-foundation.db"
    with sqlite3.connect(candidate.as_uri() + "?mode=ro", uri=True) as conn:
        by_bank = Counter()
        scoped_definitions = scoped_forms = 0
        present = set()
        cohort = hashlib.sha256()
        for entry_id, lemma, raw in conn.execute(
            "SELECT d.entry_id,l.lemma,d.domains FROM definition_states d JOIN lexemes l ON l.id=d.lexeme_id ORDER BY d.entry_id"
        ):
            cohort.update(json.dumps([entry_id, lemma], separators=(",", ":")).encode() + b"\n")
            if lemma in common:
                present.add(lemma)
                scoped_definitions += 1
                for bank, values in json.loads(raw).items():
                    if len(values) > 1:
                        by_bank[bank] += 1
        scoped_forms = len(present)
    save(
        "ssl-api-runtime-checkpoint-demand.json",
        {
            "format": "GSE.runtime-checkpoint-demand/1",
            "code": "CHECKPOINT_DEMAND_OPEN",
            "candidate": str(candidate),
            "definition_identity_digest": cohort.hexdigest(),
            "workload_freeze_sha256": fingerprint(HERE / "ssl-api-runtime-workload-freeze.json"),
            "common_forms": len(common),
            "common_forms_present_as_lemmas": scoped_forms,
            "common_forms_without_lemma": sorted(common - present),
            "definitions_for_common_forms": scoped_definitions,
            "open_definition_bank_cells_by_bank": dict(by_bank),
            "important_caveat": "Absent lemma is NOT itself failure when morphology/grammar supplies a structural home. These are all-sense demand candidates, not permission to fill all open banks or treat source silence as zero. Exact required-cell/sentence failures are in the separate final benchmark report.",
            "blocking_obligations": [
                "Independent final semantic labels and two-sided per-form missing-sign audit across this frozen cohort",
                "Actual required sense/bank resolutions, not mere token recognition",
                "Full repertoire composed consumer outcomes",
                "Full candidate replay and integrated repository gate before activation",
            ],
            "writes": {"lexicon": 0, "rules_admitted": 0, "model_calls": 0, "pointer": 0},
        },
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
